title: Tier-Qualifying Spend and the Upgrade Tier: Marlowe Rewards Ledger Calculation Note
content:
This note gives the Marlowe Rewards calculation of the tier a membership's tier-qualifying spend has reached.

## Tier-qualifying spend

The tier-qualifying spend is the qualifying spend on the membership's earning entries posted in the current calendar year, less the reversed spend on its reversal entries posted in the current calendar year. It is kept to the cent before it is compared with the thresholds.

## Thresholds

| Tier | Tier-qualifying spend at which it is reached (USD) |
|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Silver | 350.00 |
| Marlowe Rewards Gold | 750.00 |
| Marlowe Rewards Platinum | 1500.00 |
| Marlowe Rewards Icon | 3000.00 |
| Marlowe Rewards Atelier | 6000.00 |

Spend below 350.00 reaches no tier above Marlowe Rewards Member.

## The resulting tier

A membership is upgraded when its tier-qualifying spend reaches the threshold of a tier above the tier held. It moves straight to the highest tier whose threshold that spend meets. This rule never lowers a tier: the resulting tier is the higher of the tier reached and the tier held.

## Worked examples (hypothetical memberships)

| Earning entries this year (qualifying spend) | Reversal entries this year (reversed spend) | Tier-qualifying spend | Tier held | Resulting tier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1240.00 | 95.50 | 1144.50 | Marlowe Rewards Silver | Marlowe Rewards Gold |
| 1720.40 | 100.00 | 1620.40 | Marlowe Rewards Silver | Marlowe Rewards Platinum (straight past Gold) |
| 800.00 | 50.00 | 750.00 | Marlowe Rewards Member | Marlowe Rewards Gold (the threshold is met at exactly 750.00) |
| 600.00 | 0.00 | 600.00 | Marlowe Rewards Gold | Marlowe Rewards Gold (not lowered) |
| 349.99 | 0.00 | 349.99 | Marlowe Rewards Member | Marlowe Rewards Member |
